Notification email preview

81 contexts, rendered by src/notifications/email_html.py, email_html_arm.py and email_visuals.py with synthetic data only (made-up symbols, ids and levels). Each frame is the HTML part; the plain-text part below it is sent unchanged. Regenerate with .venv/Scripts/python.exe docs/design/notifications/gen_preview.py.

Visual elements

#ElementLayoutsSamples
V1Hero row
A glyph tile (a WGL4 symbol, or two pause bars for a halt) beside the badges and the headline.		L1 to L6none
V2Rule-level ladder
PASS · FLAG · SOFT · HARD, the current level marked; HARD dashed when capped at SOFT.		L1none
V3Halt-level ladder
NONE · SOFT · HARD with what each level lets through.		L2none
V4Ordinal stop ladder
Proposed stop, current stop and (with show_levels) entry in price order, fixed spacing, not to scale.		L5 ADJUSTnone
V5Advice stepper
Heads-up → Final advice (→ Released), the current step marked.		L5 ADJUST, COMPLETEnone
V6Count tiles
Big number over its label (catch-up counts, ALIVE counts).		L3, L6none
V7Time strip
Two times in order with the body's own duration text, not to scale.		L3 catch-up, L5 PRE / delayednone
V8Side chips
Neutral LONG (BUY) / SHORT (SELL) pills, the same style for both sides.		L4, L5, L6none
V9Numbered steps
"What to do" as numbered steps with a command chip.		L1 re-page, L4 pingnone
V10Summary chips
One chip per card label with its count, for notices with 2 or more cards.		L5, L6none
